[2026-09-03_ALGO]  
Video Title: Algorand Accumulation Zones: Finding the Support Levels Before the Rally  
Video ID: GHU9Sf1OLTo  
Algorand (ALGO) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
The live price of ALGO sits at approximately 9.1¢, just below its 20‑day SMA of 9.5¢, indicating a mild bullish bias. The composite risk score is currently 9/100, reflecting a low‑to‑moderate accumulation risk within the 31/100 accumulation zone. Social sentiment over the past 7 days has shifted slightly bullish, with YouTube‑derived chatter trending toward “bullish” narratives, while the broader market remains marginally bearish. The 90‑day performance shows a –1.8% decline, outperforming peers who are down roughly –8%.

Macro Quantitative Risk  
The TWAP baseline for ALGO is anchored near 9¢, with a TWAP risk level of 1.8/100 based on volatility and beta weighting. Regression‑based fair‑value bands place the current price at the lower edge of the green accumulation zone (5–6¢ to 9¢) and well below the peak fair‑value of 23¢. The residual undervaluation zone is roughly –15% relative to the regression channel, suggesting a potential upside if the asset re‑enters the green zone. Time‑weighted average price (TWAP) has drifted from 48¢ in 2022 to 41¢ today, a deviation of 76.7%, implying that a 3‑year projection to a 30¢ TWAP could represent a 3× rally.

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecasts over a 10‑week horizon yield a bare case of 6.7¢, a base case of 8–9¢, and a bull case of 12¢. The regression model projects a 2028–2029 peak near 30¢ (≈3× current price). Panic‑drawdown support floors are estimated at 4¢, while non‑panic floors sit near 5¢. Macro moving‑average supports include the 20‑day SMA at 9.5¢ and a 50‑day SMA around 10¢. The cycle bull target, derived from the gravity model, sets a north‑star of 77¢ (≈8.5× current price) if the asset class follows a typical 60‑day base growth pattern. The composite risk remains below 10/100, and the market cap, currently under 1B, could expand to 8.5× with renewed interest.
